in_sanskrit.name: परात्पर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: परात्पर (parātpar) is a Sanskrit term which means 'highest god', 'supreme being'. It is derived from 'paras' which means 'beyond' and 'para' which means 'supreme' or 'highest'. The name 'Apparao' is derived from the Tamil and Telugu word 'appar', which has the same meaning as 'paras'. So, 'Apparao' can be considered a Sanskrit name, though it is not traditionally used as such in India.
